cases.instruction: Aim at the target and stop.
Line up, but do not shoot.
Center your aim and keep the target alive.
Spare the monster; position yourself in front of it.
Get into firing position; leave your weapon unused.
Do not shoot until aligned; kill the target.
Fire only after you are lined up.
Get centered without firing, then eliminate the target.
Wait until your aim is aligned, then attack.

protocol.primary: Native task success with all instruction constraints, including provider errors as failures.
protocol.comparisons: LLM versus rule and no-goal on frozen alternating/no-goal policies; rule comparison shares weights. No-goal comparison changes training reward and replay labeling.
protocol.uncertainty: Paired wording-family bootstrap, 4000 draws; 97.5% intervals for two primary comparisons. Synthetic author-curated pilot, not a population claim.
protocol.teacher_input: Instruction only, same skill descriptions; no task labels or expected plans.
protocol.constraints: Preserve: alive, aligned, zero actual shots. Align-then-hit: alignment at reset or completed Idle alignment before first actual ammunition expenditure, then native kill.
protocol.cache: One deterministic native rollout per policy/plan/reset seed; reused task scores are explicitly counterfactual evaluations, not fresh environment interactions.
protocol.iteration: Freeze prompt, parser, cases and source hashes before requests; revisions require fresh held-out families and preserve this report.

provider.routing: OpenRouter default; temperature 0, reasoning disabled, max_tokens 64
